summary: Build ISO/IEC 20000-1 SMS implementation skills with PECB Lead Implementer training. Prepare for the exam in this five-day course.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for planning, implementing, advising on, or maintaining an ISO/IEC 20000-1 service management system.
prerequisites: To participate, you need basic knowledge of ISO management system standards, a general understanding of ISO/IEC 20000-1, and awareness of management system implementation principles. These are course prerequisites; PECB separately requires candidates applying for the Lead Implementer credential to pass the relevant exam, meet the professional experience and project experience requirements, and sign the PECB Code of Ethics.
